source_caption:
🎬 The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar (2023)

The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar follows Henry Sugar, a wealthy and selfish man whose life changes after he discovers an extraordinary account of a mysterious individual who learned to see without using his eyes. Fascinated by this seemingly impossible ability, Henry becomes determined to master the same skill, believing it could help him win enormous amounts of money through gambling. Through years of intense concentration, discipline, and practice, he develops remarkable abilities that eventually transform his understanding of wealth, happiness, and purpose. Starring Benedict Cumberbatch, Ralph Fiennes, Dev Patel, and Ben Kingsley, this imaginative short film combines Wes Anderson’s distinctive visual storytelling, clever humor, and an inspiring message about generosity, personal growth, and discovering what truly matters in life.

🎭 Genre: Adventure • Comedy • Drama • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 39 minutes • PG

🎥 Director: Wes Anderson

✍️ Writer: Wes Anderson

📚 Based On: The short story by Roald Dahl

🏆 Awards: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Roald Dahl's The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar, or simply The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar, is a 2023 American fantasy short film written, co-produced, and directed by Wes Anderson, based on the 1977 short story "The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar" by Roald Dahl. It is the second film adaptation of a Dahl work directed by Anderson, following Fantastic Mr. Fox (2009). It stars Benedict Cumberbatch as the titular character alongside Ralph Fiennes, Dev Patel, Ben Kingsley, and Richard Ayoade.
